title.en: An Act Granting to Hector A. Torres a Franchise to Install, Operate and Maintain An Electric Light, Heat and Power System in the Barrio of Magallon, Municipality of Isabela, Province Ot Occidental Negros, Philippine Islands.

text.en:
Subject to the rules and conditions established in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and
thirty-six, there is hereby granted to Hector A. Torres, for a period of fifty years from the approval of this Act,
the right, privilege and authority to construct, maintain and operate an electric light, heat and power for sale
within the limits of the barrio of Magallon, municipality of Isabela, Province of Occidental Negros, Philippine

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 8, 1932.
